name: (Risen Nemesis) Indignant Curse
text:
Trigger The Risen Nemesis critically fails a save

---
Effect The Risen Nemesis curses the creature who created the triggering effect with bad luck by sneering or shouting a cutting insult. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 42 Will save save. On failure, the Risen Nemesis can reroll the triggering roll and take the better result of the two (a fortune effect); the cursed creature must make their next d20 roll twice and take the worse result (a misfortune effect).
